title: Implement credential clearing on session end
description: Implement clearing of database credentials when the session ends (page refresh, close, or navigation away).
acceptanceCriteria: Credentials are cleared on page refresh
Credentials are cleared on page close
Credentials are not recoverable after session end
New connection is required after session end
